description: Haiti - Airports is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Haiti. Based on WFP layer, we cross-checked it with other layers such as OSM, Google Maps and Where We Fly - Mission Aviation Fellowship - Haiti. Coverage: Haiti. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Haiti. Its tags are geodata, transportation. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-10-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
